long_biography.plain_text:
Worklio founder Robert Österlund wrote Payroll Unlocked to explain the practical work behind paying employees. Drawing on his experience both funding payroll as an employer and building the systems that process it, he covered tax filing, money movement and operating risks. The book includes worked scenarios and procedures intended for use by payroll teams.

He also used his earlier email business to support a community fundraising effort. Following the Sandy Hook school shooting, he promoted an online campaign through Inbox.com that raised more than $17,600 before fees. The proceeds went to the school's parent-teacher association for classroom and community programmes supporting students.
